description: Q&A script for deep research agent expediter questions

entries.question_pattern: What topic would you like me to research?
Would you like to set a budget limit in dollars? Say a dollar amount, or 'no limit'.
Who is the target audience? Options: beginner, intermediate, expert, or academic.
Any additional context about the audience? Say 'none' to skip.
Which local document should I read first? Describe it or say the filename.
entries._comment: "none" ON PURPOSE. `source_document` is OPTIONAL (row 14c54c10), so an unattended run has no document to name; answering with a path would make every proxied research run silently read a fixture and report on it. Required by test_deep_research_covers_all_fallback_questions and test_all_agents_profile_covers_all_arg_names, which demand an entry for every fallback question the contract declares.

The DOCUMENT CHOICE CARD, keyed on the card's own id rather than its wording (row a1420538) — the same generic entry every other file-arg profile carries, because the card names itself via card_id. Added when deep research declared its own file-typed argument `source_document` (row 14c54c10). NOT REACHABLE ON THIS COMMAND TODAY, and deliberately so rather than by oversight: `source_document` is OPTIONAL, so it never enters extraction.missing and the fuzzy_file_match handler that raises this card never fires for it. The entry is here so the card is ANSWERED the day it becomes reachable — when the file browser lands, or if the argument ever gains a special handler — instead of an automated run hitting an unanswered card and cancelling. test_every_file_arg_has_a_profile_that_answers_it enforces exactly this and is what caught its absence.

entries.question_pattern: Would you like to proceed with these settings?
